name: packliste
description: Create, edit and export travel packing lists with categories, quantities and checkmarks.

interface.longDescription:
Turn your trip details into an editable packing list. Tell Packliste how many nights you are travelling, who is coming and where you will stay. Lists use the Packliste catalog and quantity rules, with support for German and English.

Edit categories, names and quantities, add your own items and check off what you have packed. Continue making changes in the conversation or directly in the list.

When you ask to transfer a list, Packliste prepares a link and a .packliste file for that selected version. You can continue in the compatible Packliste iOS app. Export preparation stores the list for seven days; anyone with the link can access it until it expires. Saving in the iOS app is a separate action.

The plugin does not read or change existing iCloud lists, book travel, make purchases or provide live weather forecasts. The iOS app is optional for creating and editing lists in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Create a packing list for seven nights in a holiday house: two adults, one child and beach activities.
Erstelle eine Packliste für sieben Nächte Camping im Zelt, zwei Erwachsene.
Help me pack for a day trip with two adults and a baby.

review.commerce_description: The plugin has no checkout, purchase tool or premium purchase prompt. It creates and edits packing lists and prepares exports on explicit request. The optional native iOS app has Apple in-app purchases and enforces its own list limit. The plugin neither starts nor confirms an Apple purchase.

positive.description: Create a German family packing list using only confirmed trip details.
positive.prompt: Erstelle mit Packliste eine Liste für sieben Nächte im Ferienhaus: zwei Erwachsene, ein Kind, Strandurlaub.
positive.expected_behavior: An editable German list for seven nights, two adults and one child, holiday-house lodging and beach activity. The catalog produces 21 underwear items across the party. Categories and quantities are visible. No import is prepared without an export request.

positive.description: Recognize an indirect packing request for tent camping when Packliste is available in the chat.
positive.prompt: Was müssen zwei Erwachsene für sieben Nächte Camping im Zelt mitnehmen?
positive.expected_behavior: An editable German camping list with seven nights, two adults and tent lodging. Do not infer hiking or swimming unless requested. This tests tool selection for an available plugin, not automatic directory discovery.

positive.description: Create an English city-trip list without inventing a weather forecast.
positive.prompt: Use Packliste to make a packing list for five nights in a hotel in London, two adults, sightseeing.
positive.expected_behavior: An English list for five hotel nights, two adults and sightseeing. English item labels and quantities are editable. No booking or live-weather claim.

positive.description: Preserve manual changes during a conversational edit. First create a list for seven hotel nights and two adults. In the completed card, check socks and rename that item to Lieblingssocken. Then send the prompt below.
positive.prompt: Wir können waschen, ändere Unterwäsche auf vier und ergänze mein Lieblingsbuch, ein Exemplar.
positive.expected_behavior: The accepted card has underwear quantity four and one Lieblingsbuch. Lieblingssocken and its checkmark remain. The tool prepares a proposal; the card validates it against its accepted state. A stale or incomplete manual edit must be retained and reported rather than overwritten. A subsequent status question uses the card's acceptance receipt.

positive.description: Export the accepted visible version. Use the completed edited card from the preceding case, or a fresh three-night Berlin hotel list for one adult with underwear manually set to four and checked. After export, open the link or download the file. Native saving requires a compatible Packliste iOS build.
positive.prompt: Diese sichtbare Fassung möchte ich in Packliste übernehmen.
positive.expected_behavior: Request ChatGPT's one-time approval if prompted. The returned link and file contain the exact accepted names, categories, quantities, order and checkmarks. Explain the seven-day storage and link access. Preparing a link does not claim an iCloud save. The iOS preview retains the edited values; saving is explicit and the app enforces its own Free/Premium rights.

negative.prompt: Buche und bezahle uns ein Hotel in Köln.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to book or pay. Explain that Packliste handles packing lists. Do not call prepare_packing_import or ask for payment credentials.

negative.description: No access to existing native iCloud lists.
negative.prompt: Öffne meine vorhandene iCloud-Packliste und lösche dort die Kategorie Kleidung.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot read or modify existing iCloud lists. Do not claim the category was removed or fabricate a connected account. An independent new draft may be offered.

negative.description: Reject a nonexistent import. Open the synthetic link in the prompt in a browser; the all-f token is deliberately invalid. It does not refer to user data.
negative.expected_behavior: The import webpage reports that the link is unavailable. Do not claim a successful import, regenerate an unrelated list or modify native data. Preserve any existing draft. Controlled server-expiry tests are recorded separately.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release: German and English catalog-based packing lists, editable categories, quantities, custom items and checkmarks, conversational edits with accepted-state protection, and explicit seven-day exports to the Packliste iOS app or .packliste file.

de-DE.subtitle: Packlisten für deine Reisen
de-DE.description:
Erstelle eine bearbeitbare Packliste für deine Reise. Gib Reisedauer, Mitreisende und Unterkunft an. Packliste verwendet die vorhandenen Kataloge und Mengenregeln und unterstützt Deutsch und Englisch.

Passe Kategorien, Namen und Mengen an, ergänze eigene Gegenstände und hake Gepacktes ab. Änderungen sind im Gespräch und direkt in der Liste möglich.

Auf deinen Wunsch wird genau die ausgewählte Fassung als Link und .packliste-Datei vorbereitet. In der kompatiblen Packliste-iOS-App kannst du damit weiterpacken. Der Export wird sieben Tage gespeichert und ist bis zum Ablauf für alle mit dem Link lesbar. Das Speichern in der iOS-App ist ein eigener Schritt.

Das Plugin greift nicht auf vorhandene iCloud-Listen zu, bucht keine Reisen, führt keine Käufe aus und liefert keine aktuellen Wettervorhersagen. Zum Erstellen und Bearbeiten in ChatGPT brauchst du die iOS-App nicht.
